templates.text: {tribute} sprints straight into the Cornucopia, grabs a gleaming backpack, and escapes into the treeline unscathed.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} wrestle over a tempered machete at the edge of the Cornucopia; {tribute_a} overpowers {tribute_b} and strikes a fatal blow.
{tribute} trips over their own untied shoelaces during the countdown, faceplants into the dirt, and decides to just lie there pretending to be a rock until everyone leaves.
{tribute_a} hurls a throwing knife across the clearing, catching {tribute_b} mid-sprint before they reach cover.
{tribute} ignores the Cornucopia entirely, bolting into the dense pine forest to secure a hidden water source.
{tribute_a}, {tribute_b}, and {tribute_c} clash in a chaotic three-way brawl over a crate of rations; {tribute_a} emerges victorious while {tribute_b} and {tribute_c} fall.
{tribute} snatches a coil of rope and a canteen from the pedestal just as arrows whiz past their ear.
{tribute} steps off their metal launch plate a fraction of a second too early—the perimeter mines detonate instantly.
{tribute_a} corners {tribute_b} against a supply crate and eliminates them in the opening minutes of the Games.
{tribute} grabs a bright neon backpack, sprints into the woods, and unzips it only to find 47 rubber ducks and a note from the Gamemakers saying "Good luck lol."
{tribute_a} shoves {tribute_b} into the Cornucopia moat. {tribute_b} makes a very dramatic splash and an even more dramatic exit. 💥
{tribute} finds a hidden compartment under the Cornucopia steps containing a thermal cloak and dried jerky.
{tribute_a} swings a heavy spear at {tribute_b}, driving them back into the brush with a deep gash.
{tribute} freezes in panic at the sound of the gong, narrowly ducking a stray arrow before scrambling into a hollow log.
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b} while {tribute_b} is rummaging through a medical crate, ending their run early.
{tribute} manages to snag a sleek trident from the weapon rack and retreats to high ground.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} lock eyes over the last remaining first-aid kit, play a frantic round of Rock-Paper-Scissors, and honor the outcome before running opposite ways.
{tribute} gets trampled in the initial stampede toward the center, escaping with bruised ribs and no supplies.
{tribute_a} uses a wooden shield to bash {tribute_b} unconscious, finishing them off before the first cannon even echoes.
{tribute} scoops up a box of waterproof matches and a bundle of dried meat before vanishing into the fog.
{tribute_a} fires a bow from atop the Cornucopia horn, picking off {tribute_b} as they flee toward the river.
{tribute} discovers a camouflage tarp near the edge of the clearing and wraps themselves in it to blend into the moss.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} engage in a brutal fistfight in the mud; {tribute_a} lands a decisive blow, eliminating {tribute_b}.
{tribute} grabs a bright orange backpack that turns out to be packed with nothing but empty flasks and tangled wire.
{tribute_a} throws a heavy axe across the field, striking {tribute_b} squarely between the shoulders.
{tribute} slips through the chaos unnoticed, securing a small pocketknife and a flask of clean water.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} collide at full speed near a supply pile; {tribute_a} recovers faster and eliminates {tribute_b}.
{tribute} grabs a shiny frying pan from the Cornucopia, bonks a charging rival on the helmet with a loud CLANG, and sprints into the bushes.
{tribute_a} chases {tribute_b} into a thorn thicket, cornering and eliminating them.
{tribute} escapes the bloodbath completely untouched, finding a quiet cave overlooking the valley.
A wall of Gamemaker-engineered wildfire sweeps through the eastern woods; {tribute} barely outruns the flames, singeing their boots.
Thick, acidic fog rolls into the canyon overnight; {tribute} inhales the toxic fumes before reaching high ground, succumbing to the poison.
{tribute} accidentally disturbs a humming nest of Tracker Jackers; stung repeatedly, they hallucinate and wander off a steep cliff.
A sudden flash flood surges down the riverbed, washing away {tribute}'s makeshift camp and soaking their supplies.
{tribute} mistakes a bush of deadly Nightlock berries for wild blueberries and eats a handful—a cannon fires moments later.
Freezing hail pelts the arena for six straight hours; {tribute} huddles beneath an overhanging boulder, shivering violently through the night.
A pack of engineered wolf mutts emerges from the mist, hunting {tribute} down before they can climb a tree.
{tribute} steps onto a disguised pressure plate, triggering a volley of wooden darts; they dodge all but one, taking a grazing wound to the shoulder.
Lightning strikes a towering dead oak directly above {tribute}'s shelter; the crashing timber crushes them instantly.
{tribute} tries to look cool while doing parkour over a fallen log, slips on wet moss, and aggressively argues with a squirrel for twenty minutes out of sheer embarrassment.
The Gamemakers trigger a localized earthquake, opening a deep fissure in the valley floor that swallows {tribute} whole.
Swarming monkey mutts descend from the canopy, screeching furiously; {tribute} fends them off with a burning branch.
{tribute} gets caught in a thick patch of quicksand near the marsh, barely pulling themselves free using a low-hanging vine.
Temperatures plummet below freezing overnight; {tribute} fails to start a fire and succumbs to severe hypothermia before dawn.
A sudden flock of razor-beaked jabberjays mimics {tribute}'s most embarrassing middle school memories on loop, dealing devastating emotional damage.
{tribute} wanders too close to the arena's invisible forcefield, getting violently flung backward into a pile of rocks.
A landslide of loose scree tumbles down the mountain pass; {tribute} is buried beneath tons of rock.
{tribute} taps a maple tree with a makeshift spile, discovering a refreshing source of clean sap and water.
Toxic spores erupt from giant puffball mushrooms in the swamp; {tribute} holds their breath and sprints to clear air just in time.
{tribute} is bitten by a camouflaged viper while gathering firewood; without antivenom, the venom proves fatal within an hour.
Blistering heatwaves bake the open plains; {tribute} suffers severe heatstroke and collapses in the tall grass.
A Gamemaker fireball explodes fifty yards from {tribute}'s camp, scorching their backpack and forcing them to relocate.
{tribute} slips on wet moss along a waterfall ledge, plummeting into the jagged rocks below.
Heavy jungle mist blinds the arena for an entire day; {tribute} uses the cover to quietly relocate without being spotted.
A mechanical snare snaps around {tribute}'s ankle, hoisting them upside down like a piñata until they awkwardly saw through the rope three hours later.
{tribute} eats spoiled meat salvaged from an old camp, suffering severe food poisoning through the night.
Razor-sharp steel wire strung between two birch trees catches {tribute} mid-sprint in the dark.
{tribute} finds a cluster of edible wild tubers and roasts them over a carefully concealed smokeless fire.
A pack of jackal mutts corners {tribute} against a cliff face; {tribute} fights valiantly before being overwhelmed.
Torrential monsoon rains flood {tribute}'s dugout shelter, forcing them to spend the night perched in a swaying tree fork.
{tribute} spends four hours painstakingly building a luxury pine-needle bed, lies down, and immediately realizes they built it directly on top of a fire ant hill.
A cloud of hallucinogenic pollen drifts across the meadow; {tribute} becomes convinced they are a majestic swan and aggressively hisses at passing trees.
{tribute} falls through thin ice on a high-altitude tarn, freezing before they can haul themselves back onto the bank.
{tribute} weaves a sturdy basket out of willow reeds and catches three plump trout in a shallow stream.
Swarming flesh-eating beetles erupt from a rotting log {tribute} sat upon; {tribute} bolts into the river to wash them off.
A Gamemaker lightning storm targets the tallest trees in the sector; {tribute} stays low in a ditch and survives unscathed.
{tribute} inhales thick smoke while trying to escape a brushfire, collapsing from asphyxiation.
{tribute} constructs a camouflaged tree blind high in the pines, sleeping safely through the night completely undetected.
Giant mutated hornets chase {tribute} for two miles until {tribute} dives beneath a waterfall to break their trail.
{tribute} steps on a rusted bear trap hidden beneath autumn leaves, severing their mobility and leaving them stranded.
{tribute} discovers a hidden natural hot spring, washing off days of grime and soothing sore muscles.
Acid rain begins to drizzle over the northern sector; {tribute} shelters beneath a thick slate overhang until the clouds pass.
{tribute} misjudges a leap across a narrow gorge, losing their footing and falling into the abyss.
{tribute} successfully snares a wild rabbit, enjoying a hearty meal that restores their strength.
A sudden sinkhole opens beneath {tribute}'s sleeping bag; they scramble out just as the earth swallows their gear.
{tribute_a} stalks {tribute_b} through the dense ferns for hours before striking silently from behind.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} clash in a fierce sword duel by the river; {tribute_a} disarms {tribute_b} and lands the finishing blow.
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b} at dusk, but {tribute_b} fights back ferociously and escapes into the shadows.
{tribute_a} drops out of a tree onto {tribute_b} like a very serious squirrel. {tribute_b} never sees it coming, or going. 💥
{tribute_a} spots {tribute_b}'s campfire from a ridge and looses a single, deadly arrow into the camp.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} trade heavy blows in a rocky ravine before {tribute_a} pins {tribute_b} and ends the fight.
{tribute_a} sets a deadfall log trap along a game trail; {tribute_b} walks right beneath it.
{tribute_a} chases {tribute_b} across a boulder field, throwing a spear that grazes {tribute_b}'s leg before {tribute_b} vanishes into a cave.
{tribute_a} sneaks into {tribute_b}'s camp while {tribute_b} is asleep, eliminating them quietly before dawn.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} battle furiously in waist-deep water; {tribute_a} forces {tribute_b} under until the bubbles stop.
{tribute_a} lures {tribute_b} into a narrow canyon ambush with fake footprints, striking them down with a heavy club.
{tribute_a} throws pocket sand into {tribute_b}'s eyes during a dramatic standoff, shouts "SHA-SHAW!", and sprints away with {tribute_b}'s snacks.
{tribute_a} catches {tribute_b} off-guard while {tribute_b} is tending to a wound, delivering a swift final strike.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} cross blades in a clearing; {tribute_b} parries a fatal thrust and sprints away into the mist.
{tribute_a} pushes a massive boulder off a cliff edge, crushing {tribute_b}'s camp below.
{tribute_a} tracks {tribute_b}'s bloody footprints through the mud, cornering and eliminating them near a waterfall.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} engage in a brutal close-quarters struggle; {tribute_a}'s superior training prevails.
{tribute_a} attempts to assassinate {tribute_b}, only for {tribute_b} to turn the tables and eliminate {tribute_a} instead!
{tribute_a} hurls a jagged stone at {tribute_b}'s temple, knocking them unconscious before finishing the job.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} lock eyes across a clearing, engage in an intense staring contest for four straight minutes, blink at the exact same time, and awkwardly walk away.
{tribute_a} poisons an unattended canteen left near a stream; {tribute_b} finds it, drinks deeply, and collapses.
{tribute_a} leaps across two boulders to tackle {tribute_b} off a narrow mountain trail.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} clash during a heavy downpour; {tribute_a} slips in the mud, allowing {tribute_b} to strike a fatal blow.
{tribute_a} uses a slingshot to pelter {tribute_b} from the treetops, driving {tribute_b} out of the sector without a scratch.
{tribute_a} corners {tribute_b} inside a dead-end cavern; a single cannon echoes seconds later.
{tribute_a} lassos {tribute_b} at the watering hole with a coil of paracord and drags them off to the cannon. Rodeo rules apply. 💥
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} fight over a dropped supply crate; {tribute_a} slashes {tribute_b}'s arm and claims the crate while {tribute_b} retreats.
{tribute_a} lights {tribute_b}'s dry brush shelter ablaze in the dead of night, eliminating {tribute_b} in the smoke and flames.
{tribute_a} jumps out from behind a hedge with a sharpened pike. {tribute_b}, who was admiring the hedge, is sent home. 💥
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} trade arrows from opposite sides of a gorge until both run out of ammunition and retreat.
{tribute_a} catches {tribute_b} climbing a cliff face and cuts {tribute_b}'s climbing rope.
{tribute_a} overpowers {tribute_b} in a frantic grapple, seizing {tribute_b}'s own knife to eliminate them.
{tribute_a} stalks {tribute_b} to the edge of a Tracker Jacker nest and intentionally drops a branch onto the hive, causing the swarm to swarm {tribute_b}.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} collide in the fog; startled, both scream like banshees and bolt in opposite directions.
{tribute_a} executes a clean, ruthless ambush on {tribute_b} as {tribute_b} bends down to tie their boots.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} team up briefly to corner {tribute_c} in a gully, jointly eliminating {tribute_c} before splitting the loot.
{tribute_a} fends off a coordinated ambush by {tribute_b} and {tribute_c}, slaying {tribute_b} in the process while {tribute_c} flees!
{tribute_a} throws a net woven from vines over {tribute_b}, immobilizing and eliminating them with ease.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} duel atop a fallen redwood trunk spanning a chasm; {tribute_b} loses balance and plunges below.
{tribute_a} shoots a flaming arrow into {tribute_b}'s camp, forcing {tribute_b} to abandon all their food and gear.
{tribute_a} tries to dramatically monologue about their inevitable victory before attacking {tribute_b}, only to realize {tribute_b} quietly walked away twenty minutes ago.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} wrestle by a rock outcrop until {tribute_b} slips on a patch of moss and bonks into the stone. {tribute_a} wins on a technicality. 💥
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b} from beneath a pile of fallen leaves, eliminating them in seconds.
{tribute_a} attempts to snipe {tribute_b} from a ridge, missing by inches and giving away their own hiding spot.
{tribute_a} corners {tribute_b} against the arena forcefield; {tribute_b}'s own weapon bounces back off the field, allowing {tribute_a} to finish them.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} clash in a furious hand-to-hand brawl; {tribute_a} breaks {tribute_b}'s guard and lands a lethal blow.
{tribute_a} lays a tripwire linked to a sharpened sapling; {tribute_b} triggers it while sprinting through the woods.
{tribute_a} steals {tribute_b}'s boots while {tribute_b} is bathing in a creek, leaving {tribute_b} barefoot on rocky terrain.
{tribute_a} hunts {tribute_b} relentlessly across three sectors before finally catching up and eliminating them.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} fight to an exhausting stalemate, both limping away with minor cuts and bruises.
{tribute_a} drops heavy stones from a cliff ledge onto {tribute_b} below, knocking {tribute_b} out cold before descending to finish them.
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b} at a river crossing, sweeping {tribute_b} off their feet and eliminating them in the rapids.
{tribute_a} uses a camouflage cloak to let {tribute_b} walk right past them before striking {tribute_b} from behind.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} accidentally wear matching moss camouflage outfits, pause mid-battle to compliment each other's style, and agree to call it a draw.
{tribute_a} catches {tribute_b} unarmed while gathering berries, ending {tribute_b}'s Games swiftly.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} cross paths near the river, lower their weapons, and form an official alliance for mutual survival.
{tribute_a}, {tribute_b}, and {tribute_c} band together into a three-person pack, establishing a fortified camp on high ground.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} split their rations evenly around a hidden fire, taking turns keeping watch through the night.
{tribute_a} treats {tribute_b}'s infected wound with medicinal herbs, cementing a loyal partnership between the two.
{tribute_a} decides {tribute_b} has outlived their usefulness—while {tribute_b} sleeps, {tribute_a} betrays and eliminates their ally!
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} work together to haul a heavy crate out of a ravine, sharing the supplies inside.
{tribute_a} spots an ambush approaching their camp and pulls {tribute_b} to safety just in time.
Tensions boil over between allies {tribute_a} and {tribute_b} over dwindling water; {tribute_a} draws a blade and strikes {tribute_b} down.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} coordinate a synchronized hunt, trapping and eliminating {tribute_c} between them.
{tribute_a} sneaks out of their shared camp before sunrise, stealing {tribute_b}'s backpack and dissolving their alliance.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} huddle together under a single thermal tarp to survive a freezing mountain gale.
{tribute_a} uses {tribute_b} as bait to lure {tribute_c} into the open—eliminating {tribute_c}, though {tribute_b} barely survives the trap!
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} spend three hours around a smokeless campfire aggressively debating whether a hotdog is a sandwich, somehow bonding deeply over it.
{tribute_a} slips deadly berries into {tribute_b}'s stew during dinner, coldly eliminating their unsuspecting ally.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} patrol the forest perimeter back-to-back, deterring nearby tributes from attacking.
{tribute_a} rescues {tribute_b} from a deep mud pit, pulling their ally free moments before a flash flood hits.
Realizing only one tribute can go home, {tribute_a} turns on {tribute_b} during a river crossing, pushing them into the falls.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} agree to an unspoken temporary truce while sheltering together in a cave during a hailstorm.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} spend the afternoon teaching a local raccoon to steal supplies from other camps, naming it their official District mascot.
{tribute_a} abandons an injured {tribute_b} when wolf mutts howl nearby, leaving {tribute_b} to fend for themselves.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} pool their sponsorship gear together, dramatically increasing their combined combat readiness.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} stage a fake argument to lure {tribute_c} out of hiding, ambushing and eliminating {tribute_c}.
{tribute_a} refuses to betray {tribute_b} despite an easy opening, choosing loyalty over a quick elimination.
{tribute_a} stabs {tribute_b} in the back while {tribute_b} is distracted watching a hovercraft collect a fallen tribute.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} build a camouflaged lean-to out of pine boughs, sleeping soundly through the night.
{tribute_a} shares their last flask of clean water with a dehydrated {tribute_b}, saving {tribute_b} from collapsing.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} mutually decide to part ways peacefully as the arena shrinks toward the final showdown.
{tribute_a} pushes {tribute_b} directly into the path of a Gamemaker fireball to buy themselves time to escape!
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} successfully defend their hilltop camp against a midnight raid by {tribute_c}, eliminating {tribute_c}.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} forage together along the riverbank, gathering enough roots and fish to last two full days.
The Gamemakers announce a Feast at the Cornucopia! {tribute} sprints in, grabs a heavy pack of supplies, and bolts out unharmed.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} collide at the Feast table; {tribute_a} slams {tribute_b} onto the metal floor and eliminates them.
{tribute} decides the Feast is an obvious trap, staying safely hidden in the trees while cannons boom in the distance.
{tribute_a} snipes {tribute_b} from the treeline just as {tribute_b} reaches for a silver medical bag at the Feast!
{tribute_a}, {tribute_b} and {tribute_c} brawl over one crate. {tribute_a} knocks both rivals out of the Games with a single swing of a serving platter. The Capitol would like its platter back. 💥
{tribute} sneaks up to the Cornucopia under smoke cover, snatches a bundle of rations, and slips away unseen.
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b} on the path back from the Feast, stealing their newly won supplies and eliminating them.
{tribute} arrives late to the Feast, finds nothing left except a single stale breadstick, and angrily eats it in the bushes.
Wielding their sponsored Tempered Machete / Trident, {tribute_a} effortlessly overpowers {tribute_b} in a deadly duel!
{tribute} spots a silver parachute drifting down into a nearby clearing, racing to retrieve it before anyone else notices.
{tribute_a} attempts to intercept a silver parachute meant for {tribute_b}, only for {tribute_b} to ambush and eliminate {tribute_a}!
{tribute} strikes a dramatic main-character pose on a cliff edge overlooking the arena, immediately ruins it by sneezing violently, and hides behind a bush.
The Gamemakers force all remaining tributes toward the central lake with walls of rolling fire; {tribute} barely reaches the shore alive.
Driven out of hiding by encroaching poison gas, {tribute_a} runs straight into {tribute_b}'s ambush and is eliminated.
{tribute} gazes up at the night sky as the Capitol anthem plays, counting the fallen portraits projected in the clouds.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} spot each other across the central lake, knowing the final showdown is only moments away.
{tribute} bandages a minor scrape with torn fabric, conserving their energy while other tributes exhaust themselves fighting.
{tribute_a} hurls a trident across the lake. It lands near {tribute_b}, who yells "missed me!" exactly one second too early. 💥
{tribute} hides inside the hollow metallic shell of the Cornucopia during a torrential storm, staying dry and hidden.
{tribute_a} catches {tribute_b} distracted by the sound of an approaching hovercraft, striking them down cleanly.
{tribute} discovers an abandoned backpack containing an extra roll of bandages and dried apple slices.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} clash in a desperate, all-out battle on the Cornucopia steps; {tribute_a} lands the final strike!
Surrounded by rising floodwaters, {tribute_a} overpowers {tribute_b} in the churning rapids to claim survival!
{tribute_a} outmaneuvers {tribute_b} in the burning woods, knocking {tribute_b} back into the inferno.
Exhausted and bruised, {tribute_a} lands a decisive counter-strike against {tribute_b} as the final cannon echoes across the arena!
{tribute} tracks a wounded rival through the tall grass, patient and silent like a predator.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} trade desperate blows in the mud; {tribute_a} grabs a jagged rock and ends the struggle.
{tribute} finds a cache of dry kindling and roasts wild roots, keeping out of sight while cannons boom in the distance.
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b} at the edge of the cliffs, sending {tribute_b} tumbling down into the rocky gorge.
{tribute} listens carefully to the rustling canopy, avoiding a disguised snare by mere inches.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} sprint toward the last high ground as the arena floods; {tribute_a} reaches the peak first and kicks {tribute_b} back into the torrent.
{tribute} spends the whole day perfectly still inside a hollow log. A deer sits on it for an hour. Neither party mentions it.
{tribute} builds a leaf fort so convincing that a squirrel moves in and starts paying rent.
{tribute} hides up a tree and practices their victory speech in a whisper. It needs work.
{tribute} smears mud on their face for camouflage and accidentally looks extremely cool.
{tribute} finds a cave, declares it 'the Bunker', and refuses to come out until further notice.
{tribute} naps under a pile of ferns and wakes up with a beetle sitting on their nose like a tiny hat.
{tribute} hides so well that the Capitol camera crew spends forty minutes filming a rock by mistake.
{tribute} watches a fight from a bush, eating trail mix like it's movie night.
{tribute} spends the night counting stars from a hidden ledge and gets to 4,000 before losing track.
{tribute} digs a cozy burrow and sleeps like a very anxious badger.
{tribute} whispers 'you didn't see me' to a passing hovercraft. It doesn't see them.
{tribute} drapes moss over themselves and holds a perfect statue pose for six hours. The pose is a flex.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} pick the same hiding bush, stare at each other in silence, and silently agree it's big enough for two.
{tribute} hides in the river reeds breathing through a hollow stem, then realizes it's a straw from a juice box.
{tribute} sleeps through the entire night undisturbed. The Gamemakers find this personally offensive.
{tribute} rearranges their hideout three times and settles on 'cozy cottagecore bunker'.
{tribute} forages a hatful of wild strawberries and eats them one at a time with great ceremony.
{tribute} catches a fish with their bare hands, screams, and drops it back in the river. Progress.
{tribute} collects pine nuts all afternoon and now rattles slightly when they walk.
{tribute} finds wild mint and spends the evening with very fresh breath and no dinner.
{tribute} rigs a rain catcher out of leaves and a sock. The water tastes like sock. Still water.
{tribute} sets a snare, checks it, and finds a very disappointed rabbit who is let go with a stern warning.
{tribute} roasts mushrooms over a tiny fire after checking them against a poster they remember from training.
{tribute} discovers a cluster of edible roots and names each one before eating it.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} both reach for the same apple tree, shrug, and split the harvest down the middle.
{tribute} fishes with a bent hairpin and lands a trout bigger than their dignity.
{tribute} gathers enough berries for three days and eats all of them in one sitting.
{tribute} finds a bird's nest, apologizes to the bird, and leaves empty-handed. The bird is unmoved.
{tribute} spends the day weaving a fishing net and catches a boot. It's a nice boot.
{tribute} raids an abandoned camp and finds half a granola bar and someone's diary. The diary is better.
{tribute} taps a birch tree for sap and gets a sticky, sweet, deeply unhelpful amount of it.
{tribute} cooks a stew of foraged greens that tastes exactly like a lawn. Nutritious lawn.
{tribute} stalks a rival for an hour before realizing it was their own shadow.
{tribute} sharpens a stick into a spear, then sharpens it again, and now has a toothpick.
{tribute} follows fresh footprints in a circle for three hours. They are their own footprints.
{tribute} practices throwing knives at a tree and hits it once. The tree has learned nothing.
{tribute} climbs a ridge to scout for rivals and sees only a very smug eagle.
{tribute} sets an ambush on a game trail and catches nothing but a sunburn.
{tribute_a} spots {tribute_b} across a ravine. They both wave out of habit, then feel weird about it.
{tribute_a} chases {tribute_b} through the woods until both get winded and sit down on the same log.
{tribute_a} throws a rock at {tribute_b} and misses so badly that {tribute_b} gives them a pity thumbs-up.
{tribute_a} ambushes {tribute_b}, trips on a root mid-leap, and both of them decide to pretend it never happened.
{tribute_a} and {tribute_b} trade insults across a stream for twenty minutes. {tribute_b} wins on creativity.
{tribute_a} steals {tribute_b}'s backpack, opens it, finds only socks, and gives it back out of pity.
{tribute} tracks a rival by the sound of their snoring, then loses them when the snoring stops.
{tribute} lies in wait all night with a slingshot and accidentally ambushes a moth.
{tribute_a} sneaks up on {tribute_b}'s camp at night, sneezes, and has to sprint away into the dark.
{tribute_a} lands a glancing blow on {tribute_b} before {tribute_b} vanishes into the brush, yelling about rematches.
{tribute} spends the day composing a heroic ballad about themselves. It has nine verses and no rhymes.
{tribute} waves at the hidden cameras every hour, on the hour, to stay relevant with sponsors.
{tribute} has a long, emotional conversation with a tree. The tree is a good listener.
{tribute} attempts a cartwheel to impress sponsors and lands in a bush. The sponsors are impressed anyway.
{tribute} names a friendly crow 'Kevin' and now has one ally the Gamemakers didn't plan for.
{tribute} gets lost, finds their camp, and gets lost again, all in the same afternoon.
{tribute} carves their name into a tree so future tributes know they were here. They misspell it.

bloodbath_intro: The gong sounds. Twelve-ish hearts pound. Everyone sprints for the Cornucopia at once.
Sixty seconds on the plates, then chaos. The Bloodbath begins!
The launch plates rise. The Cornucopia glitters. Somebody already regrets their life choices.
day_intro: The sun rises over the arena. Somewhere a bird sings. Somewhere else, someone is plotting.
Another day in the arena. The sponsors are watching. So are the mutts.
Morning mist lifts off the arena. The tributes are on the move.
The Capitol cameras swivel into place. A new day begins.
night_intro: Night falls. The anthem plays and the faces of the fallen light up the sky.
Darkness settles over the arena. Every twig snap sounds like a threat.
The temperature drops. The anthem plays. Nobody in the arena sleeps well.
The moon comes up over the arena. So do the night creatures.
feast_intro: Claudius Templesmith's voice booms: 'Attention tributes! A Feast awaits at the Cornucopia. Each of you needs something badly...'
The Gamemakers announce a Feast at dawn. Backpacks with district numbers glint on a table at the Cornucopia.
finale_intro: The arena shrinks. Walls of fire herd the last tributes toward the Cornucopia. This is it.
The Gamemakers have had enough. Floodwaters rise, pushing the survivors together for the final showdown.
A howl rolls across the arena. Mutts drive the remaining tributes into the open. Only one walks out.

📢 RULE CHANGE! 'Tonight, all weapons are replaced with pool noodles!' Nobody can tell if they're joking.
📢 RULE CHANGE! 'Every tribute must compliment another tribute before sundown!' Things get awkward.
📢 RULE CHANGE! 'Hugs now count as attacks.' The arena goes very, very quiet.
📢 RULE CHANGE! The Gamemakers announce a mandatory nap. Everyone is suspicious. Everyone naps.
📢 RULE CHANGE! 'The tribute with the best dance moves gets a prize!' There is no prize.
